title: Entity list views with sortable, filterable tables
description:
Build the 'easy-to-read tables' the user asked for: a reusable data-table component and per-type list pages (All Yachts, Builders, Yacht Clubs, Marinas, People, Regions...). Columns chosen per entity type from its common attributes (e.g. Yachts: name, builder, LOA, year, owner, weekly rate, guests). Client-side column sorting, per-column text/range filters, and pagination or virtualized scroll for large sets (yachts number in the thousands). Rows link to detail pages. Clean, readable, non-technical styling.

Part of Phase 2 (UI foundation). Directly serves the 'get tables' half of the goal.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable table component renders any node type with type-appropriate columns
List pages exist for Yacht, Builder, YachtClub, Marina, Person, and Region
Columns are sortable and support per-column filtering (text and numeric range where relevant)
Large tables (thousands of yachts) remain smooth via pagination or virtual scroll
Each row links to the entity detail page; empty and loading states are handled
